mapper.select: SELECT tbl_cart.id, mst_product.image_full_path, mst_product.product_name, mst_product.price, tbl_cart.product_count, (mst_product.price * tbl_cart.product_count) as subtotal FROM tbl_cart, mst_product WHERE tbl_cart.user_id = #{userId} AND tbl_cart.product_id = mst_product.id ORDER BY tbl_cart.updated_at DESC, tbl_cart.created_at DESC
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM tbl_cart WHERE id IN
#{id}
